Option A is more likely. This rests on domain knowledge, and I did not run any statistical test on the data. A radiculopathy is a pathophysiological diagnosis, and a nerve-root lesion produces pain in the area that root supplies. Heel pain is a symptom, so it would be the effect. Heel pain doesn't cause a nerve-root lesion.

The L/R mismatch in A is odd, since an S1 root usually produces pain on its own side. That doesn't change the direction of the relationship, so I still choose A.

ANSWER: A
